title: P vs B Pairs
subtitle: Voiceless vs Voiced Stops
description: The sounds /p/ and /b/ are made in exactly the same place, but /p/ is a puff of air and /b/ uses your voice. Mixing them up can completely change a word's meaning.
tip: Hold your hand in front of your mouth — /p/ makes a strong burst of air, while /b/ barely moves air at all.
phrases: Pack your bag and put it in the back of the bus.
The pet bat and the big black cat sat by the pot.
Please bring the peach pie and blueberry bread.
Ben paid a pound and a bit for the bunch of plums.
The park bench broke when the big boy bumped it.
Pam and Bob both picked up the broken blue cup.
